appDescription.message: Bloque les sites qui te distraient pendant tes heures de focus et affiche ton objectif à la place. Sans compte, sans pistage.
appDescription.description: Chrome Web Store short description, 132 characters max.

appName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store, the toolbar and every page header.

appShortName.description: Short extension name (12 characters or fewer).

badge_title_active.description: Toolbar icon tooltip during a block. {1} is a clock time like 14:00.

bg_title_missing_one.message: 1 site a besoin d'un accès. Clique sur l'icône pour l'autoriser.
bg_title_missing_one.description: Toolbar icon tooltip, extra line when exactly one blocked site lacks the host permission. That site is still blocked during a block, with Chrome's error page; allowing access shows the goal page instead. Never say it is not blocked.

bg_title_missing_other.message: $p1$ sites ont besoin d'un accès. Clique sur l'icône pour les autoriser.
bg_title_missing_other.description: Toolbar icon tooltip, extra line when several blocked sites lack the host permission. {1} is the number of sites (2 or more). They are still blocked during a block, with Chrome's error page; allowing access shows the goal page instead. Never say they are not blocked.

bg_title_next.description: Toolbar icon tooltip, second line, when no block is active. {1} is a weekday and time, e.g. 'Monday 07:00'.

blocked_amount_error.message: Entre un montant entier entre $p1$ et $p2$.
blocked_amount_error.description: Error for an invalid custom amount. {1} and {2} are formatted amounts.

blocked_amount_label.description: Accessible label of the amount choice and input.

blocked_back.description: Blocked page: primary button, closes the tab

blocked_close_tab.description: Blocked page: button that closes the tab

blocked_continue.description: Blocked page: button that opens the original page. {1} is the site host

blocked_ended_next.description: Shown when a scheduled block starts later. {1} is a day and time.

blocked_ended_sub.message: Ton objectif t'attendra la prochaine fois.

blocked_ended_title.description: Title once the session was ended early.

blocked_focus_left.description: Blocked page: label under the big countdown (reads like '42:17 of focus left')

blocked_free_ended.message: Ton temps de focus est terminé. Bien joué.
blocked_free_ended.description: Blocked page: sub line when the block ended

blocked_free_generic_sub.description: Blocked page: sub line when nothing is blocked and the original address is unknown

blocked_free_open.description: Blocked page: sub line when the site is no longer part of what is blocked

blocked_free_title.description: Blocked page: title when the block ended or a pass is active

blocked_free_title_generic.description: Blocked page: title when no block is active and the original address is unknown

blocked_friction_accents_hint.message: Pas besoin de taper les accents.
blocked_friction_accents_hint.description: Unlock flow: small line under the sentence to type, only shown when it contains accented letters (they are optional)

blocked_friction_cancel.description: Unlock flow: link that leaves the flow and goes back to the blocked page

blocked_friction_end.description: Button that ends the whole session once the sentence is typed.

blocked_friction_failed.description: Generic error when ending the session fails.

blocked_friction_hint.message: Ton focus se termine dans $p1$. Ça peut attendre ?
blocked_friction_hint.description: Unlock flow, step 1: line under the question. {1} is the time left in the block, like '45 min' or '1 h 05'

blocked_friction_hint_generic.message: Se reconcentrer prend plus de temps qu'on croit.
blocked_friction_hint_generic.description: Unlock flow, step 1: line under the question when the end of the block is unknown

blocked_friction_input_label.description: Unlock flow: label and placeholder of the typing field

blocked_friction_no.description: Unlock flow, step 1: answer that goes back to work (closes the tab like 'Back to work')

blocked_friction_paste.message: Le copier-coller est désactivé. Tape-la toi-même.
blocked_friction_paste.description: Unlock flow: shown when the user tries to paste or drop text ('it' is the sentence)

blocked_friction_phrase.message: Je choisis de renoncer à mes objectifs. J'échange mes aspirations et mes engagements contre quelques minutes de distraction.
blocked_friction_phrase.description: Unlock flow: default sentence the user must type by hand, used unless they wrote their own in the settings. Keep straight apostrophes, no characters that are hard to type

blocked_friction_progress.description: Unlock flow: typed characters counter, e.g. '42 / 150'

blocked_friction_progress_label.description: Unlock flow: accessible name of the progress bar

blocked_friction_question.message: Ça vaut vraiment le coup d'interrompre ton focus ?
blocked_friction_question.description: Unlock flow, step 1: the only question before typing the sentence

blocked_friction_type.message: Tape cette phrase pour arrêter ta session
blocked_friction_type.description: Title of the typing step (free way to end the session early).

blocked_friction_typo.message: Faute de frappe. Reprends là où ça s'est arrêté.
blocked_friction_typo.description: Unlock flow: shown when a wrong character is typed (it gets removed)

blocked_friction_yes.description: Unlock flow, step 1: answer that continues to the typing step

blocked_goal_add.description: Blocked page: link to the settings page to write a goal

blocked_goal_empty.description: Blocked page: shown under 'Remember why' when the user has not written a goal

blocked_goal_title.description: Blocked page: small heading above the user's goal

blocked_host.description: Blocked page: small top line and tab title. {1} is the site host, e.g. linkedin.com

blocked_host_generic.description: Blocked page: top line and tab title when the original address is unknown

blocked_need.description: Blocked page: discreet button that starts the unlock flow

blocked_no_end.description: Blocked page: shown instead of the countdown when the block has no end in the next days

blocked_no_session_sub.message: Il n'y a rien à arrêter pour l'instant.

blocked_no_session_title.description: End-session page opened when nothing is blocked.

blocked_pay_button.description: Pay button. {1} is a formatted amount like 5 €.

blocked_pay_retry.description: Retry button after a payment error.

blocked_pay_skip.description: Secondary button: end the session for free by typing the sentence instead.

blocked_pay_timeout.message: Aucun paiement reçu pour l'instant. Réessaie quand tu es prêt.
blocked_pay_timeout.description: Shown after waiting a long time for a payment.

blocked_pay_title.description: Title of the step where the user pays to end the session early.

blocked_pay_unavailable.message: Le paiement n'est pas disponible pour l'instant. Tu peux toujours passer gratuitement.
blocked_pay_unavailable.description: Error when the payment server can't be reached.

blocked_resisted_many.description: Blocked page: stat line. {1} is a number of 2 or more

blocked_resisted_one.message: Tu as résisté une fois aujourd'hui
blocked_resisted_one.description: Blocked page: stat line when the user went back to work once today

blocked_step.description: Blocked page: unlock flow step, read by screen readers (the page shows dots)

blocked_until.description: Blocked page: end time of the block under the countdown. {1} is a clock time

blocked_waiting_reopen.description: Link that reopens the Stripe page.

blocked_waiting_sub.message: Paie dans le nouvel onglet. Cette page se met à jour toute seule.

blocked_waiting_title.message: En attente de ton paiement de $p1$
blocked_waiting_title.description: Title while the Stripe page is open. {1} is the formatted amount.

category_messaging.description: Preset group name: Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp Web, Messenger...

category_news.description: Preset group name: news and sports sites.

category_shopping.description: Preset group name: Amazon, eBay, Vinted...

category_social.description: Preset group name: Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, LinkedIn...

category_video.description: Preset group name: YouTube, Netflix, Twitch...

common_add.description: Generic button to add an item (site, time slot).

common_allow.description: Button that asks Chrome for access to the listed sites. They are blocked either way; with access they show the goals page instead of Chrome's error page.

common_back.description: Button to go back to the previous step.

common_cancel.description: Generic button to cancel an action.

common_close.description: Generic button to close a notice or a panel.

common_coffee.description: Link to the optional tip page (Stripe), shown in the popup footer and the settings page.

common_continue.description: Button to go to the next step.

common_delete.description: Generic button to delete an item for good (for example a time slot).

common_done.description: Generic button to confirm and close.

common_hours_short.description: Short duration in whole hours, e.g. 1 h. {1} is a number.

common_loading.description: Accessible label shown while data loads.

common_minutes_short.description: A number of minutes, short form. {1} is the number.

common_open_settings.description: Button that opens the settings page.

common_other.description: Button to pick a custom value (for example a custom number of minutes).

common_remove.description: Generic button to remove an item from a list.

common_save.description: Generic button to save a change.

common_saved.description: Short status shown after an automatic save.

common_settings.description: Link or button that opens the settings page.

common_start.description: Button that starts a focus session.

common_version.description: Extension version line. {1} is the version number, like 1.0.0.

goal_option_focus.message: Améliorer mon focus et ma productivité

goal_option_projects.message: Avancer à fond sur mes projets
goal_option_projects.description: Suggested long-term goal, the default one.

home_active.description: Home page, while a block is active.

home_idle.description: Home page, when no block is active.

home_page_title.description: Browser tab title of the home page. {1} is the app name.

home_start.description: Home page button that starts a session. {1} is a number of minutes (15).

nav_home.description: Left menu tab to the home page (current session).

nav_stats.description: Left menu tab to the stats page.

onb_amount_error.message: Choisis un montant entier entre $p1$ et $p2$.
onb_amount_error.description: Inline error for an invalid custom amount. {1} and {2} are formatted amounts, like €1 and €500

onb_amount_input_label.description: Screen reader label of the field where the user types a custom amount

onb_amount_label.description: Screen reader label of the row of amounts in the money choice

onb_amount_other.description: Last button of the amount row: reveals a field to type any amount

onb_amount_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the custom amount field, shown next to the currency sign. {1} and {2} are the limits (1 and 500)

onb_custom_placeholder.description: Placeholder and label of the input where the user types a site to block (a domain or a full URL)

onb_custom_remove.description: Screen reader label of the remove button on a site the user added. {1} is the domain

onb_days_label.description: Screen reader label of the weekday toggles in onboarding step 2

onb_doc_title.description: Browser tab title of the onboarding page. {1} is the app name

onb_done_title.description: Heading of the onboarding done screen

onb_edit.description: Short button on a selected group card that shows its sites, so some can be turned off

onb_error_invalid_time.description: Schedule validation error: empty or incomplete time

onb_error_no_day.description: Schedule validation error: no weekday selected

onb_error_same_time.message: Le début et la fin doivent être différents.

onb_focus_until.description: Done screen button label once the session has started. {1} is a time, e.g. 14:10

onb_from_label.description: Screen reader label of the start time input in onboarding step 2

onb_goal_empty.message: Écris ton objectif, ou choisis-en un au-dessus.

onb_goal_label.description: Screen reader label of the goal input

onb_goal_placeholder.description: Example in the custom goal field.

onb_missing_one.description: Done screen line before an Allow link: one chosen site lacks access, so it is blocked with Chrome's error page instead of the goal page

onb_mode_free.description: Onboarding step 4 choice: ending a session early never involves money

onb_mode_free_sub.message: Tu tapes une phrase pour arrêter une session avant la fin.

onb_mode_money_sub.message: Arrêter une session avant la fin coûte le montant choisi.

onb_money_skip.description: Says clearly that paying is never required.

onb_money_why.message: Un petit prix pour marquer une pause et réfléchir.

onb_pick_one.message: Choisis un groupe ou ajoute un site.

onb_pin_line.description: Done screen line: pin the extension icon in the Chrome toolbar to start focus sessions

onb_sites_one.description: Site count on an onboarding group card, exactly one site

onb_step4_title.message: Si tu veux arrêter avant la fin

onb_strict_free.message: Pour arrêter avant : tape une phrase.

options_undo.description: Button in a notification that brings back what was just deleted.

popup_allow_site_title.message: Affiche ton objectif ici au lieu d'une page d'erreur
popup_allow_site_title.description: Tooltip of the Allow button next to the current site in the popup. The site is already blocked (with Chrome's error page); access upgrades it to the goal page

popup_already_blocked.description: Popup chip when the current site is already on the block list

popup_block_site.description: Popup button adding the current site to the block list

popup_countdown_label.description: Screen reader label before the popup countdown

popup_custom_error.description: Popup validation error for the custom duration (whole minutes only). {1} and {2} are the min and max minutes

popup_custom_label.message: Durée de la session en minutes
popup_custom_label.description: Screen reader label of the custom duration field

popup_custom_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the custom duration field. {1} and {2} are the min and max minutes

popup_custom_start.description: Popup button starting a session with a custom duration

popup_dismiss.description: Accessible label of the close button on a popup notice

popup_end_session.description: Discreet link under the timer: opens the ritual to end the session early.

popup_error_generic.description: Popup fallback error when no specific reason is available

popup_extend.description: Popup button extending the block. {1} is a number of minutes

popup_finish_setup.description: Popup button shown until onboarding is finished; reopens onboarding

popup_idle_title.description: Popup status title when nothing is blocked

popup_load_error.description: Popup error when the background does not answer

popup_meta_join.description: Joins the two parts of the popup active sub line, e.g. 'Until 14:00' and '14 sites blocked'

popup_missing_many.message: $p1$ sites affichent une page d'erreur au lieu de ton objectif.
popup_missing_many.description: Popup banner when several blocked sites lack host access: they are still blocked, but with Chrome's error page; the Allow button next to it upgrades them to the goal page. {1} is a number above 1

popup_missing_one.message: $p1$ affiche une page d'erreur au lieu de ton objectif.
popup_missing_one.description: Popup banner when one blocked site lacks host access: it is still blocked, but with Chrome's error page; the Allow button next to it upgrades it to the goal page. {1} is a domain, e.g. 'linkedin.com'

popup_next_block.description: Popup idle sub line. {1} is a weekday and time, e.g. 'Monday 07:00'

popup_next_block_today.description: Popup idle sub line when the next scheduled block starts today. {1} is a time

popup_no_end.description: Popup active sub line, first part, when the block lasts more than 8 days

popup_progress_label.description: Screen reader label of the popup progress bar

popup_quick_label.description: Popup label above the quick session buttons (10 min, 20 min...)

popup_retry.description: Popup button retrying after a load error

popup_site_fallback.description: Small note under the current site's hostname when it is on the block list but the extension has no access to it: it is blocked with Chrome's error page instead of the goal page

popup_site_unsupported.description: Popup note when the current page (IP address, localhost, Chrome Web Store) cannot be blocked

popup_sites_many.description: Popup active sub line, second part. {1} is a number above 1

popup_sites_one.description: Popup active sub line, second part, singular

popup_sites_zero.description: Popup active sub line, second part, when the block list is empty (or every listed site has a 10 minute pass)

popup_start_other.description: Popup button revealing a custom duration field

popup_stats.description: Accessible label and tooltip of the stats button.

popup_streak_many.description: Streak chip in the popup header. {1} is a number of days.

popup_streak_one.description: Streak chip in the popup header (one day).

popup_title_schedule.description: Popup status title during a scheduled time slot

popup_title_session.description: Popup status title during a manual session

popup_until.description: Popup active sub line, first part: when the block ends. {1} is a time today ('14:00') or a weekday and time ('Monday 07:00')

privacy_line.message: Rien n'est envoyé, ni à nous ni à personne. Pas de compte, pas de pistage.
privacy_line.description: Privacy promise shown on the settings page. Settings can sync through the user's own Chrome sync, so it must not claim that nothing leaves the browser.

reason_duplicate_domain.description: Validation error when adding a site that is already in this list.

reason_invalid_domain.message: Ça ne ressemble pas à un site. Essaie exemple.fr.
reason_invalid_domain.description: Validation error when adding a site to a group or to the user's own sites.

reason_invalid_groups.message: Impossible d'enregistrer ce groupe. Vérifie son nom et ses sites.
reason_invalid_groups.description: Error when a group can't be saved: empty or too long name, invalid site, too many groups or sites.

reason_invalid_minutes.description: Validation error for a custom session length.

reason_invalid_phrase.message: Entre 40 et 300 caractères sur une ligne, ou laisse vide.
reason_invalid_phrase.description: Validation error for the custom sentence typed to end a session early (40 to 300 characters, one line, or empty for the default sentence).

reason_invalid_request.message: Ça n'a pas marché. Recharge et réessaie.
reason_invalid_request.description: Generic refusal for a malformed request.

reason_invalid_schedule.message: Choisis un jour et une heure de fin différente du début.
reason_invalid_schedule.description: Validation error for a time slot: at least one day, and the end time must differ from the start time.

reason_invalid_unlock.description: Validation error when the way to end a session early can't be saved: the amount must be a whole number from 1 to 500 (currency not shown).

reason_lock_custom.message: Pendant un blocage, tu peux ajouter des sites, pas en retirer.
reason_lock_custom.description: Refusal: the user tried to remove one of their own sites ("Your sites") during an active block.

reason_lock_group.message: Pendant un blocage, tu ne peux ni désactiver ni supprimer un groupe actif.
reason_lock_group.description: Refusal: the user tried to turn off or delete a group that is on, during an active block. Turning groups on, adding groups and sites stays allowed.

reason_lock_group_site.message: Pendant un blocage, tu peux ajouter des sites à un groupe actif, pas en retirer.
reason_lock_group_site.description: Refusal: the user tried to remove a site from a group that is on, during an active block.

reason_lock_phrase.message: Tu pourras changer ta phrase à la fin du blocage.
reason_lock_phrase.description: Refusal: the user tried to change or reset the custom unlock sentence during an active block.

reason_lock_reset.message: Tu pourras tout réinitialiser à la fin du blocage.
reason_lock_reset.description: Refusal: the user tried to reset every setting during an active block (only when the build locks reset during blocks).

reason_lock_schedule.message: Pendant un blocage, tu peux ajouter ou activer des créneaux, pas les modifier.
reason_lock_schedule.description: Refusal: the user tried to edit, disable or delete an existing time slot during an active block (adding a slot or turning a disabled one on stays allowed).

reason_no_response.description: Error when the background service worker did not answer.

reason_not_blocked.message: Rien n'est bloqué en ce moment.
reason_not_blocked.description: Refusal: ending a session early (or a 10 minute pass, no longer offered) was asked while no block is active.

reason_payment_not_verified.message: Ton paiement n'est pas encore confirmé.
reason_payment_not_verified.description: Refusal: the user asked to end the session with a payment, but the payment server says this Stripe payment is not paid (yet).

reason_payment_unavailable.message: Le paiement est indisponible pour le moment. Réessaie.
reason_payment_unavailable.description: Error when the payment server can't be reached or gives an unexpected answer (offline, timeout, server error).

reason_storage_error.message: Échec de l'enregistrement. Réessaie dans un instant.
reason_storage_error.description: Error when Chrome refused to write the settings (for example too many saves in a short time).

reason_too_many_domains.message: Tu as atteint la limite de 200 sites.
reason_too_many_domains.description: Validation error when the user's own site list ("Your sites") is full.

reason_unknown.description: Fallback error message for an unexpected problem.

stats_blocked_sub.message: Fois où un site bloqué a affiché ton objectif

stats_completed.description: Card title: blocks that ran to their end.

stats_focus.description: Card title: time spent inside a block.

stats_focus_sub.message: Temps passé avec tes sites bloqués

stats_grid_day.description: Tooltip of a day square. {1} is a date, {2} a duration.

stats_grid_day_none.description: Tooltip of an empty day square. {1} is a date.

stats_grid_label.description: Accessible label and caption of the day grid.

stats_page_title.description: Browser tab title of the stats page. {1} is the app name.

stats_paid.description: Card title: total paid to end sessions early.

stats_paid_none.description: Card subtitle when nothing was paid.

stats_period_label.description: Accessible label of the period choice.

stats_privacy.message: Tes stats restent dans ton navigateur. Rien n'est envoyé.
stats_privacy.description: Footer line of the stats page.

stats_streak_hint.message: Un jour compte dès qu'un blocage protège au moins une minute de focus.
stats_streak_hint.description: Explains what makes a day count.

stats_streak_many.description: Current streak. {1} is a number of days.

stats_streak_none.message: Lance une session pour démarrer ta série.
